stripText.remove: Four shell diagrams are shown, labelled 1 (= option (i)), 2 (= option (ii)), 3 (= option (iii)) and 4 (= option (iv)). In diagram 1 (i) the inner (first) shell carries only about one electron while the outer (second) shell already carries electrons. In diagram 2 (ii) the first shell is drawn with about four electrons. In diagrams 3 (iii) and 4 (iv) the first shell holds two electrons and the remaining electrons are placed in the second shell.
